mapper.insert: insert into orders (order_no, pay_no, user_id, status, goods_amount, discount, freight, total,pay_method, remark, address_json, coupon_json, logistics_json, created_at, updated_at) values (#{orderNo}, #{payNo}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{goodsAmount}, #{discount}, #{freight}, #{total},#{payMethod}, #{remark}, #{addressJson}, #{couponJson}, #{logisticsJson}, now(), now())
insert into order_items (order_id, shop_id, product_id, title, sku, qty, price, art_img, created_at) values (#{orderId}, #{shopId}, #{productId}, #{title}, #{sku}, #{qty}, #{price}, #{artImg}, now())
mapper.select: select o.*, r.remind_count, r.last_remind_time from orders o left join seller_reminders r on r.order_id = o.id where exists (select 1 from order_items i where i.order_id = o.id and i.shop_id = #{shopId}) and o.status = #{status} order by o.id desc limit #{offset}, #{size}
